title: B1.11 AgeTracer one-substep effluent age output increments

baseline.source_equation: AgeTracer task-2 icAgetopupw, icAgerot, per-level icAgedra and icAgebot increments after updated Ageml is available

scope.inputs: Already-derived qtop/qrot/qdra/qbottom; updated candidate Ageml, previous committed cml, substep days; all are explicit
scope.equations: topup=max(0,qtop)*0.5*(Ageml(1)+cml(1))*dt; root(i)=qrot(i)*0.5*(Ageml(i)+cml(i))*dt; drain(level,i)=qdra(level,i)*0.5*(Ageml(i)+cml(i))*dt accumulated over levels then cells in B1.11 loop order; bottom=-min(qbottom,0)*0.5*(Ageml(n)+cml(n))*dt.

qualification: 100000 deterministic profiles compared to direct B1.11 formula and loop order at O0/O2
Exercise qtop both signs, root signs, multiple drainage levels, bottom both signs
Reject dimensions and nonfinite/nonpositive interval inputs
No full accumulator state or production age-output admission
decision_rule: Return each interval increment; do not substitute accumulator current values or alter B1.11 summation order.
